_note: Example Compliance node outputs demonstrating the KTD6 sentinel convention and all three compliance routes. Line 1 of each `output` is the reserved routing sentinel (COMPLIANCE=<STATUS>); human-readable prose follows on later lines. Used by Phase A tests to lock the sentinel contract and the fail-open collision guard. NEEDS_REVIEW is an execution-time addition beyond the original plan; its trigger semantics are a U4/U8 decision and are NOT defined here.

cases.name: standard_cleared
cases.output:
COMPLIANCE=CLEARED
Colombia is not restricted by the configured rules. $500 is under the $3000 reporting threshold. Cash send of $500 or more requires valid government-issued ID at the send location. Western Union and MoneyGram both support the configured USD to COP corridor.

cases.name: aml_flagged
cases.output:
COMPLIANCE=FLAGGED
Cash send amount $3500 exceeds the configured $3000 AML reporting threshold. Sender must complete required reporting at the send location before proceeding.

cases.name: collision_guard_flagged_with_cleared_prose
cases.output:
COMPLIANCE=FLAGGED
Recipient country is not cleared for the configured corridor, and the sender was not previously cleared for high-value transfers. Manual reporting is required before this transfer can proceed.

cases.name: manual_review_needed
cases.output:
COMPLIANCE=NEEDS_REVIEW
Transfer requires manual compliance review before proceeding: the sender account tier and corridor combination is not auto-clearable under the configured demo rules.
